spread_alert.interpretation: A wide min/max range is a review flag only. It does not automatically remove sales or recalculate the median.

rules: Market-record quality never upgrades secondary-source evidence to original verification.
Freshness is based on the latest stored realized-sale date.
Sample-size confidence and source verification are independent.
Price-spread alerts require manual review before any comp removal.
Record-quality calculations do not mutate committed EV or market value.
